title: Independent raw-word ledger for T74 four-role pricing change
body:
This independently reconstructs the local paid-frame change from PR2312's adopted raw words (`fb76f799`) to PR2322 (`002304ef`), for both providers. Explicit GF(2)^9 span sets confirm `Delta H={1:-8,2:+8,3:+4,4:-4,5:-4}`, four width-4 retirements, and mass -16; the witness separates all twelve changed roles and their B/terminal contributions.

The useful failure control changes twelve actual preparation charts from C4 to C5 while retaining the candidate's rank-4 handoffs. Its mass remains5371 and widths stay identical, but its rank distribution changes. Stale reporting rejects; the corrected profile passes the scoped frame ledger. A same-rank wrong-subspace control also ensures dimensions alone cannot substitute for inclusion.

The primary producer and its substantial native checks are credited. This adds a compact direct source-to-candidate witness with a different implementation, not another root evaluation or a claim that native pricing was previously unchecked.

Validation: Windows CPython3.12.11 registered normal and `-O` replay each pass8 positive and44 negative controls; package metadata/pins and all8 staged source bytes pass. A separate AI review agent's Gaussian-elimination replay independently confirms all4 raw profiles and the C5 control. Commands are in the README and VERIFY.json.

Scope: raw paid-frame pricing only. No scalar/cleanup correctness, physical phases, emitted native stream, global owners/idle invoice, moment or outer admission is certified. No selected frontier change; historical PR2312 head deliberately retained even though its live head advanced. Base canonical main0fdd7d82, priorityrevision4; fresh overlap covers567openPRs/1079Discussion records with completepagination and no warnings. PR2349 owner optimization and PR2339 later400-helper words are separate.

Coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2325#discussioncomment-18942169

Credit: Jeremy Kothe(PR2312), Vlado Vojdanovski/Vlado-V(PR2322), Douglas Colkitt and all retained generator-notice predecessors. Prepared by AAAmirinu with substantial OpenAI Codex implementation/review assistance; no human or maintainer review claimed. Apache-2.0, original notices preserved.
